name: p3_v2
contract_note: tep khong co .wav (chi kieu P4 / P5, nhan 03: ghep_*, xoa_loi*, da_hai_cho, may_*) va tep ngoai natvi / naten goc: diem 0 (khong ra dong 02)

method.frames: LightGBM tren dac trung vat ly khung 20 ms tu .wav (feats.py: 16 dai, san nhieu, bang thong, YIN, MFCC, lo pho) dang TUONG DOI cuc bo - ca tep + XLS-R PCA-64 cuc bo + xep chong diem fuse1 (train_frames.py --stack --drop-file-ctx --rel-only)  GOP logit voi TCN gian no hoc tu dau co ham mat MIL theo tieu chi giai ma (train_seq.py); trong so LightGBM den 0,5 / 0,5, voi vi 0,5 en 0,7; hau xu ly post.post2 (mo 21 khung + nang bac co tre) — voi vi: post_raw_mx (khong mo)
method.heads: vi: nen = B (LR tren XLS-R gop), giong = sigmoid(0,7 logit B + 0,3 logit A2 (LightGBM pho khung lang/noi + thong ke tep)); en: nen = B2 (LR XLS-R gop + thong ke khung XLS-R lang/noi + h2 + thong ke fuse1), giong = 0,15 h2 + 0,85 B2-DSP
method.selection: chon tren OOF 5 fold theo nguoi noi (luat cung 2), RIENG theo ngon ngu; rang buoc: vu oan moi kenh <= ngan sach + 2 do lech chuan nhi thuc, Req 4 <= nen, Req 5 >= 0,92, Req 3 >= 0,97, khong o nao tut > 5 diem

data.train: natvi / naten goc co .wav + benign (am cung), 5842 tep cho kenh khung xep chong; 12049 tep (them bien the app_*) cho TCN va dau A2 / B

unseen_tools.note: CHUA danh gia: bo du lieu hien co khong co cong cu giu kin cho 02; resenh (khu on AI) / knnvc (chuyen giong) de danh cho tap khoa P0. Viec mo.

metrics_oof_budget.ci_note: [gia tri, KTC 95 % thap, cao] bootstrap 400 lan theo cum nguoi noi (evalp3.ci_typed)

rtf_note: do tren 8 tep 4-17 s, CPU, khong tinh XLS-R / fuse1 dung chung (P0); tep 300 s chua do
weights: weights/ (khong vao git: .gitignore experts/**/weights/) — tao lai: python experts/P3/p3_v2/fit_final.py ; python experts/P3/p3_v2/train_seq.py --final --epochs 10
